blocks.content: **いちばん** (一番) means "number one" and acts as a superlative marker. It goes directly before the adjective or adverb : no change to the adjective itself.

lines: [Group] の中で、[item] が **いちばん** [adjective] です
の中で (no naka de) = "among" : optional but common

rows.japanese: クラスで田中さんが一番背が高いです。
rows.romaji: Kurasu de Tanaka-san ga ichiban se ga takai desu.
rows.english: Tanaka is the tallest in the class.

rows.japanese: 日本で一番高い山は富士山です。
rows.romaji: Nihon de ichiban takai yama wa Fujisan desu.
rows.english: Mt. Fuji is the tallest mountain in Japan.

rows.japanese: 何の科目がいちばん好きですか。
rows.romaji: Nani no kamoku ga ichiban suki desu ka.
rows.english: Which subject do you like the most?

rows.japanese: このメニューの中で一番安い料理はどれですか。
rows.romaji: Kono menyū no naka de ichiban yasui ryōri wa dore desu ka.
rows.english: Which dish on this menu is the cheapest?

rows.japanese: 世界で一番大きい国はどこですか。
rows.romaji: Sekai de ichiban ōkii kuni wa doko desu ka.
rows.english: Which is the largest country in the world?

blocks.content: いちばん can modify adjectives (一番高い), adverbs (一番速く), and nouns when paired with suki/kirai (一番好きな食べ物). It is one of the simplest patterns at N5 : the adjective needs no modification at all.
